title: Sitemap URL Extractor input
description: Add one or more websites or sitemap URLs, then click Start. The Actor finds the sitemaps, follows indexes, and returns every page URL it lists. Use Max URLs per site to bound the run; filters run before results are saved.

startUrls.title: Websites or sitemap URLs
startUrls.description: Required. One per line: a website (https://example.com, or just example.com) to find its sitemaps in robots.txt and at common paths such as /sitemap.xml, or a direct sitemap, sitemap index or .xml.gz URL. Only http and https addresses are accepted. Anything else (for example mailto:, ftp: or text that is not an address) is skipped, saved to INVALID_INPUTS and not charged.

maxUrlsPerSite.sectionDescription: Use these to cap cost and keep only the URLs you need. Filters run before results are saved, so dropped URLs are not charged.
maxUrlsPerSite.title: Max URLs per site
maxUrlsPerSite.description: Stop after this many page URLs per start entry. Default 1000, allowed 1 to 1000000. Raise it to get a full list.

includeRegex.title: Include only URLs matching (regex)
includeRegex.description: Optional regular expression. Only URLs that match are kept, for example /blog/ or /products/. An invalid expression stops the run with a message.

excludeRegex.title: Exclude URLs matching (regex)
excludeRegex.description: Optional regular expression. URLs that match are dropped, for example /tag/|/author/. An invalid expression stops the run with a message.

modifiedSince.title: Only URLs modified since (YYYY-MM-DD)
modifiedSince.description: Optional date: keep only URLs whose lastmod is on or after it. Use YYYY-MM-DD (2026-01-31) or a full ISO date-time (2026-01-31T10:00:00Z); only the date part is compared. URLs with no lastmod are dropped when this is set. Any other format fails the run at once with 'modifiedSince must look like 2026-01-31'.

checkStatus.title: Check HTTP status of each URL
checkStatus.description: When on, sends a HEAD request (GET if HEAD is refused) to every kept URL and adds statusCode and finalUrl to its row. Slower. Default: off.

maxSitemaps.title: Max sitemap files per site
maxSitemaps.description: Safety cap on how many sitemap files are read for one start entry. Default 500, allowed 1 to 10000.
